name: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden, UT) Angus Roast Beef French Dip with Melted Swiss & Au Jus
brandOrRestaurant: Mad Moose Cafe (Eden / Ogden Valley, UT)
whyItWorks: Thinly shaved tender Angus roast beef with melted low-lactose Swiss cheese on a toasted French roll. Dipped in savory, warm au jus broth that softens the bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the French Dip with au jus; ask to hold grilled onions if sensitive to cooked alliums.
watchOuts: Hold grilled onions to prevent fructan gas
